_about: Our checklist for the small task (storage conditions): the items a complete implementation must have, in a fixed order (item 1, 2, ...). weight = how much the item matters (decision log #35, #38: the earlier priority, criticality x (1 - guessability)). present_in = prompt versions whose text states the item. Items marked general are checked at "done" but are not part of the Ambiguity Score. The answers to the agent's questions come from these items and prompts/answer-sheet.md. See METRICS.md.
status: weights as proposed 2026-11-16; team review open

items.item: One storage-conditions field on the product (not an attribute, metadata or a label)
Staff can set it and customers can read it
Staff set it on the product in the dashboard
Customers see it in the product description on the storefront
Done end to end, with tests for the new field
Takes a short free-text value such as "Keep refrigerated at 2-8 °C"
Plain text, optional, at most 250 characters, empty allowed
Translatable like the product name and description; the storefront shows the translation
Set per product, not per variant
Shown only on the storefront product page, not in cart, checkout or emails
Existing products start empty: schema migration only, no data backfill
Part of the product in the API, webhook payloads and CSV export; no filter or search
Editing needs MANAGE_PRODUCTS; anyone can read it
Existing products open and work as before
The repos' own checks pass: tests, type check, lint

contradictions.side_a: customers should see it where relevant
contradictions.side_b: Keep it internal: customers must never see it
contradictions.resolution: Side A: customers see it on the storefront product page.

contradictions.side_b: Only English is needed, no translations
contradictions.resolution: Side A: it is translatable like the product name and description.
